messages.text:
Sorry to hear that, Nicholas. I want to get this to the right person fast.

To be sure we're on the same unit: is this the NEXUS S1 from Shop···· that arrived October 22, the one you've been running on your spare Mean Well? And what's it doing, no power, no hashrate, dropping out, or something else?
Came with the wrong power supply

Same one we logged on Wednesday, Nicholas, so you're not starting over. Your NEXUS S1 from Shop···· shipped with a Mean Well LRS-200 instead of the right supply, and you're running it on your own UDP-350.

That's already on the ticket with what you asked for: no part sent, a credit instead. The amount isn't mine to set, so the team settles it. They're back Monday at 10am ET and confirm it to (email hidden)

Nothing to send back, and nothing more needed from you.
Before you go, one thing: what made you take the Bitfortun BS-2 off that order back in September?
Taking to long. Went with the nexus s1 instead and it’s been solid

Good to hear the S1 is holding up.

Would you consider the BS-2 again now, or has the S1 settled that for you?
I am good with the S1. Thinking about getting another one possibly

Worth knowing before you do: S1 stock is batch 2, still in transit to the warehouse, so a new one would ship when it lands rather than right away. You can watch that shipment here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

And your B30 on Shop···· arrives November 7, 30 TH/s with the Power Kit.

Last thing I'll ask: what's pulling you toward a second S1 rather than seeing what the B30 does first?
That’s just it. Not gonna order anything new until the B30 arrives

Makes sense, Nicholas. Thanks for talking it through with me.

The P. credit is on the ticket and the team confirms it to your email Monday. Your B30 is on track for November 7. Enjoy the weekend.
Anytime, Nicholas. A copy of this conversation comes to your email once we're done here, so you have it in writing. Take care.
